The Deepathoon lamp-lighting controversy in Tamil Nadu’s Thirupparankundram hills has escalated into a legal and political confrontation. snippet.title: ট্রেনের রেললাইনের পাশে ছোট ছোট পাথর বিছানো হয় কেন? 😱🚆 #core
snippet.description:
Have you ever wondered why thousands of small stones are placed around railway tracks? 😱🚆

Most people think these are just ordinary stones. But they actually play a very important role in railway safety!

These stones are called railway ballast. They help distribute the enormous weight of trains, keep the railway tracks stable, and prevent the tracks from shifting out of position. They also help with drainage and reduce vibrations when heavy trains pass over them.

snippet.title: How Machinists Weld Steel Without a Welding Torch
snippet.description:
Rotary friction welding is a solid-state metal joining process that uses rotational movement and axial pressure to generate heat between two components. Unlike conventional arc welding, the process does not require welding wire, filler metal, or an electrical arc to create the joint.

As friction increases the temperature at the contact surfaces, the metal softens and undergoes plastic deformation. Controlled pressure brings the materials together, forming a metallurgical bond without requiring bulk melting. Excess material displaced from the joint, known as weld flash, can subsequently be removed using a lathe.

Friction welding is used in automotive manufacturing, aerospace engineering, industrial tooling, and the production of shafts and other precision components. Proper control of rotational speed, pressure, material compatibility, and temperature is essential for producing a reliable joint.

snippet.title: Daniel Thomas "Danny Tommo" Horrendous Licence Conditions?
snippet.description:
Prison release licence conditions explained: what it means to be released from prison on licence, what rules may apply, and what can happen if someone breaches them.

Being released from prison does not always mean a person’s sentence is over. Depending on the sentence, they may be supervised in the community by probation and required to follow conditions on their licence. Those conditions vary from case to case and can cover matters such as keeping in touch with probation, where someone lives, and restrictions on their activities or contact with other people.

This video explains how release on licence works in England and Wales, the difference between release and the end of a sentence, and how licence conditions relate to probation supervision. It also looks at what may happen after an alleged breach, including recall to prison, and why recall is not the same as being convicted of a new offence.

We also consider the role of parole, the purpose of licence conditions, and the balance between public protection, rehabilitation and a person’s return to life in the community.

The rules can differ according to the sentence and the individual case. This video discusses the general position in England and Wales.

snippet.description:
Ինեսայի մեծ գաղտնիքը վերջապես բացահայտվում է դպրոցում, ու Վիկայի քայլից հետո իրավիճակը դուրս է գալիս վերահսկողությունից։ Լևոնը պարզում է, թե իրականում ով է փրկել իր կյանքը, իսկ Բելլան հայտնվում է բոլորովին անելանելի վիճակում։

Այս սերիայում կտեսնեք դրամատիկ առերեսումը դասարանում, Բելլայի ու Լևոնի անկեղծ զրույցը և այն հետևանքները, որոնք կարող են ընդմիշտ փոխել հերոսների հարաբերությունները։ Լարվածությունը գնալով ավելի է մեծանում, իսկ Ինեսայի անհետացումը նոր խնդիրներ է առաջացնում։

Ի՞նչ եք կարծում, Լևոնը կների՞ Ինեսային այսքանից հետո, թե՞ նրանց հարաբերություններն ավարտվեցին․ գրեք ձեր կարծիքը մեկնաբանություններում և բաժանորդագրվեք ալիքին։
